findings.subject: Exact builtin keyword arity
findings.detail: The exact-str precheck dispatches only already-invalid shapes to typed no-body constructor binders before looking up the selected native owner. Missing, duplicate, unexpected and excess-argument precedence is left to the actual interpreter binder. Both binder parameter names/defaults match the preserved original constructors.

findings.subject: Subclass class-keyword observation
findings.detail: Making the allocation dispatcher implicit cls positional-only prevents cls= intended for a subclass initializer from being consumed or rejected as a duplicate allocation argument. Subclasses still bypass base-only selector dispatch; this is checked by planned controls, not claimed as executed.

findings.subject: 28 methods and five helper qualified names
findings.detail: Only diagnostic __qualname__ is set on the existing typed wrappers. All 28 wrapper signatures match the original ordered parameter/default signatures, with only equivalent quote spelling for rax. Successfully bound wrapper bodies continue to invoke the HIA owner. The five helper wrappers likewise retain owner.invoke bodies.

findings.subject: Complete retained-body oracle
findings.detail: After removing the two allocation dispatcher additions, the complete Function and Emitter class bodies are byte equal to the frozen original oracle: 20176 and 5528 bytes. This is a textual comparison, not a Python AST parse.

findings.subject: Narrow delta projection
findings.detail: Removing the exact new binder/helper blocks, two early check calls, positional-only slash changes and qualname additions reproduces the correct v2 backend/native baseline bytes. The old root backend at 8ddd is not the v2 staged input and was not used as the final projection baseline.

findings.subject: Existing denominator and meaningful controls
findings.detail: All 15 component method names remain in the same order; only three existing methods add bad-binding/subclass cases and 12 method bodies remain byte equal. The invalid constructor cases forbid selector observation; invalid native method/helper cases forbid HIA invocation and compare original TypeError class/args from the complete original definitions.

unexecuted: 15 component plus 51 machine plus 50 Core in the original full owner
open_boundaries: Foreign string-subclass keyword hash/equality and invalid-arity selector precedence
Private constructor/signature/default mutation and direct __new__ behavior
Stack/traceback introspection and exact resource/finalizer timing
Hosted CPython argument binding remains an explicit host primitive; this delta is not a whole-native compiler claim
review_scope: Only these exact static binding changes. Existing HIA ownership and arbitrary foreign-input equivalence are not promoted by this review. Adjacent qualifier/ledger non-use of __qualname__ was reported by the peer, not independently re-audited here.
